text:
Predicates:
GainedKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x is smarter.
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Author(y, z) ::: y is the author of z.
Title(y, t) ::: y has title t.
Harry ::: Harry (constant).

Premises:
Reads(Harry, y) ∧ Book(y) ∧ Author(y, HenryThoreau) ∧ Title(y, "Walden") ::: Harry read the book 'Walden' by Henry Thoreau.
GainedKnowledge(Harry) ::: Harry gains knowledge.

Conclusion:
GainedKnowledge(x) → Smarter(x) ::: If a person gains knowledge, then they become smarter.
